title: WabbleSpec Error Event
description: Typed error emitted by modules. Orchestration routes by type, not by prose parsing.

type.description: Error type determines routing action. See routing table.

recoverable.description: Whether execution can continue after this error

upstream_module.description: For DEPENDENCY errors: which upstream module failed

artifact.description: For SPEC_VIOLATION or STALENESS_VIOLATION: which artifact triggered the error

staleness_state.description: For STALENESS_VIOLATION: the staleness state of the offending evidence

routing.description: Orchestration routing instructions. Derived from type — set automatically.

target.description: Where to route: module name, checkpoint label, or spec stage

$comment: Routing table: SOFT=retry, HARD=halt, DEPENDENCY=pause, CONTEXT_EXHAUSTION=compress, SPEC_VIOLATION=loop_back, STALENESS_VIOLATION=quarantine
